title: Same event simulated twice per tick: rows_in double counted, data_anomalies written twice, extra sim_runs
steps: sim_runs created_at >= 2026-11-21: 203 rows for 177 events; 26 events have 2 rows with identical snapshot_ts (e.g. cfb-6cbe20aab84d37ab: created 05:08:55.366 and 05:08:57.795, pulledAt 05:08:55.209)
data_anomalies: 112 rows but only 24 unique (event_id, selection); 21 keys duplicated, incl. same-tick pairs (ids 94 and 106)
feed_filter_log id 72: sanity=19 equals the 19 anomaly rows written in that tick, which include same-tick duplicates
expected: One simulation and one set of filter counts per event per run; each bad row logged once (or deduped across ticks).
actual: tick() simulates touched events, then publishDue() calls simulateEvent+saveSim again for the same snapshot. rows_in/rows_kept/counts are inflated and anomalies duplicated. Anomalies also repeat every tick with no dedupe key. (rows_in = rows_kept + drops does add up in all 72 log rows.)
evidence: worker/src/tick.ts:144-145 and worker/src/publish.ts:136-140 both call saveSim.
